# Financial Impacts: key numbers (generated by analysis/03_financial_impacts.py)

## Data caveat: what these results mean

All results are **demonstrated reliability from the qualification test data in our parameter table**
(test temperature, hours, sample size, failures). The calculation is verified (it reproduces the course
chi-square formula and TI's published FITs), but a part's result only reflects the test data we
transcribed. For four parts the manufacturer's published FIT rests on other or more data than our table:

- **Renesas RH850:** only one 231-device HTOL test is in the table. Renesas's verified published FIT
  (0.0011) rests on much more data, so the RH850 is very likely **more reliable than our result shows**
  (our 60% FIT at 55 C is 15.5).
- **ADI LTC6811-1, ADuM141E, ADuM4135:** our table gives them **lower** FITs (0.32-0.45 at 55 C, 60%)
  than ADI publishes (11-34; LTC6811-1 verified, ADuM4135 not found in ADI's report, ADuM141E not
  checked), so their results **may be optimistic**.

So the supplier comparisons in the MCU, BMS AFE, digital isolator and gate driver slots, and the "least
reliable" combination built from these parts, compare the evidence in our table, not settled true
reliability. No supplier difference is statistically significant (Preliminary Results, 9b).

For the financial result this means: the BEFORE combination is the least reliable by the evidence in
our table, which under-rates the RH850; the purchase difference also depends on MCU proxy prices (A15).

Change: BEFORE = least reliable supplier combination, AFTER = recommended (most reliable) combination.
Per 1,000 vehicles, mission 2,920 h (A7); 5,000 paired Monte Carlo draws, seed 5300.
Purchase cost: Sheet2 distributor unit prices (Mouser, DigiKey; links in data/prices.csv).
Warranty cost: expected warranty failures x the part's unit price (parts-only, a LOWER bound;
labour and module replacement are not included).

## 55 C, Sheet2 prices (MCU family proxies)
- Before: R7F7016903AFP-C + LTC6811-1 + ADuM141E + TMP4719QDGSRQ1 + ADuM4135 + TMCS1101A4UQDRQ1
- After:  F280049CPZQR + BQ79656PAPRQ1 + ISO7741QDWRQ1 + TMP4719QDGSRQ1 + UCC21750QDWRQ1 + TMCS1101A4UQDRQ1
- Purchase cost: before 67,610.00 (95% CI 67,610.00-67,610.00; SE 0.00); after 64,530.00 (95% CI 64,530.00-64,530.00; SE 0.00)
- Expected warranty failures: before 0.042 (95% CI 0.005-0.317; SE 0.086); after 0.021 (95% CI 0.003-0.112; SE 0.030); failures avoided 0.017 (95% CI -0.049-0.267; SE 0.082)
- Warranty cost (parts-only): before 0.65 (95% CI 0.07-5.11; SE 1.39); after 0.22 (95% CI 0.03-1.08; SE 0.28)
- Total cost: before 67,610.65 (95% CI 67,610.07-67,615.11; SE 1.39); after 64,530.22 (95% CI 64,530.03-64,531.08; SE 0.28)
- Saving from the change: 3,080.39 (95% CI 3,079.72-3,084.53; SE 1.33) per 1,000 vehicles; P(after costs less) = 1.000; P(after has fewer failures) = 0.740
- Break-even repair cost: the recommended parts cost $3,080 LESS to buy per 1,000 vehicles, so the change pays off at any repair cost
